title: Design System: Response Paragraph Writing Assistant

display.purpose: One page title per screen; 30-36px on the writing desk, 36-48px on reference pages.

headline.purpose: Sheet titles; 30-36px for the marked-sheet title.

title.purpose: Part names and sub-sections; 18px variant for in-sheet h3.

body-writing.purpose: Student writing and read-back text, sitting on the 28px grid.

label.purpose: Keys for individual items (part on a note, stance, connector family). Never an eyebrow above a heading.

figures.purpose: Every count, score, limit and draft number; tabular.

score.purpose: The total inside the hand-drawn pen circle.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: Every sheet lifting off the desk (light).

shadows.name: sheet-night
shadows.purpose: Every sheet lifting off the desk (dark).

shadows.name: mark-button-hover
shadows.purpose: Primary Mark button on hover, with a 1px lift.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Writing-area focus halo in the part's highlighter.

motion.name: ease-ink
motion.purpose: Entrances, highlighter swipes, word-track fill, mode-switch thumb.

motion.name: hl-swipe
motion.purpose: Highlighter swipe left to right; 260ms stagger per segment.

motion.name: pen-draw
motion.purpose: Score circle, ticks, crosses, nav underline.

motion.name: ink-in
motion.purpose: Content and parts appearing; 70ms stagger per part.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover, colour and border transitions; 500ms for word-track width.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all animations off; pen strokes rendered fully drawn

components.name: Mark Button
components.description: The single primary action: mark the whole paragraph.
components.css: .ds-btn-mark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--ink, #1c2533); color: var(--paper, #fdfdfe); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px -6px rgba(28,37,51,0.45); transition: transform 200ms, box-shadow 200ms, background-color 200ms; } .ds-btn-mark:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); background: var(--pen, #c0392b); box-shadow: 0 10px 22px -10px rgba(192,57,43,0.6); } .ds-btn-mark:active { transform: none; } .ds-btn-mark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pen, #c0392b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-mark:disabled { opacity: 0.45; box-shadow: none; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Check Button
components.description: Outlined secondary action to check one part.
components.css: .ds-btn-check { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #1c2533); border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #1c2533); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-btn-check:hover { background: var(--ink, #1c2533); color: var(--paper, #fdfdfe); } .ds-btn-check:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pen, #c0392b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Mode Switch
components.description: Two-segment writing-mode switch on the sheet header.
components.css: .ds-switch { position: relative; display: inline-grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(28,37,51,0.14)); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--paper, #fdfdfe); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-switch-thumb { position: absolute; top: 4px; bottom: 4px; left: 4px; width: calc(50% - 4px); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--ink, #1c2533); transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-switch-tab { position: relative; z-index: 1; padding: 6px 16px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--ink-soft, #4a5568); cursor: pointer; transition: color 300ms; } .ds-switch-tab:hover { color: var(--ink, #1c2533); } .ds-switch-tab.ds-on { color: var(--paper, #fdfdfe); } .ds-switch-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pen, #c0392b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Writing Area
components.description: Squared-paper textarea; focus takes the part's ink and highlighter.
components.css: .ds-writing { display: block; width: 100%; resize: none; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, rgba(28,37,51,0.14)); border-radius: 2px; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 17px; line-height: 28px; color: var(--ink, #1c2533); caret-color: var(--pen, #c0392b); background-color: var(--paper, #fdfdfe); background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(31,78,121,0.085) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(31,78,121,0.085) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 28px 28px; background-position: -1px -1px; transition: border-color 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-writing::placeholder { color: var(--ink-faint, #6b7686); } .ds-writing:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--part-ink, #1c2533); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--hl, rgba(28,37,51,0.14)); }

components.name: Navigation

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-nav-brand { color: var(--ink, #1c2533); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-display, 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif); font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-nav-brand span { font-family: var(--font-body, 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', sans-serif); font-weight: 400; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0; color: var(--ink-faint, #6b7686); margin-left: 6px; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-soft, #4a5568); text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--ink, #1c2533); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--pen, #c0392b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-link.ds-active { color: var(--ink, #1c2533); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-link svg { position: absolute; left: 8px; right: 8px; bottom: -2px; width: calc(100% - 16px); height: 8px; color: var(--pen, #c0392b); }

components.description: Squared paper sheet on the desk with a red margin rule.

components.css: .ds-sheet { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 212px 1fr; border-radius: 4px; background-color: var(--paper, #fdfdfe); background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(31,78,121,0.085) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(31,78,121,0.085) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 28px 28px; background-position: -1px -1px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(28,37,51,0.06), 0 12px 32px -12px rgba(28,37,51,0.18); color: var(--ink, #1c2533); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-sheet::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 212px; width: 1px; background: rgba(214,69,65,0.55); } .ds-sheet-margin { padding: 28px 20px; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono', monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-sheet-body { padding: 28px 40px 28px 24px; } .ds-sheet-body h2 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display, 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif); font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-sheet-body p { font-size: 17px; line-height: 28px; }

components.css: .ds-onGrid { font-family: var(--font-body, 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 17px; line-height: 28px; color: var(--ink, #1c2533); } .ds-hl { background-image: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent 0, var(--hl) 0.15em, var(--hl) calc(100% - 0.1em), transparent 100%); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: 100% 78%; background-position: 0 60%; -webkit-box-decoration-break: clone; box-decoration-break: clone; border-radius: 0.2em 0.35em 0.25em 0.3em; padding: 0 0.08em; animation: ds-swipe 750ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) both; } @keyframes ds-swipe { from { background-size: 0% 78%; } to { background-size: 100% 78%; } }

components.name: Circled Score
components.description: Score in mono, circled in red pen that draws on.
components.html: 19/20
components.css: .ds-score { position: relative; display: inline-grid; place-items: center; margin: 24px 40px; color: var(--pen, #c0392b); } .ds-score svg { position: absolute; left: -22%; top: -30%; width: 144%; height: 160%; pointer-events: none; } .ds-score path { stroke-dasharray: 1; stroke-dashoffset: 1; animation: ds-pen 600ms cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1) forwards; } .ds-score-num { position: relative; padding: 0 4px; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono', monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 48px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; } .ds-score-num small { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 400; } @keyframes ds-pen { to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }

narrative.overview:
Everything happens on a sheet of squared paper lying on a pale blue-grey desk. The student writes in ballpoint navy, each of the four paragraph parts is swiped with its own highlighter, and the marking comes back in red pen: a hand-drawn circle around the score, ticks and crosses in the rubric, bracketed notes in the margin. There is no editor chrome and no AI sidebar; the sheet is the interface, and the red margin rule divides the margin (word track, Mark button, score, per-part key) from the writing.

Density is classroom-practical: generous 28px line spacing that sits text on the grid, compact 12-14px helper text, figures always in tabular mono so counts and scores read like a tally. Light mode is daylight on white paper; dark mode is the same sheet under a desk lamp, with the pen warming to coral and highlighters dimmed to keep contrast. The world uses no texture, no handwriting fonts and no page curl; its only hand-made gestures are the SVG pen strokes and the highlighter swipe.
keyCharacteristics: Squared paper sheets (28px grid) with a red vertical margin rule, floating on a flat desk colour.
Navy ink for all text and primary actions; red pen reserved for marking, scores, errors and focus.
Four part highlighters, each paired with a darker part ink for text that names the part.
Tabular mono figures for every count, score and number.
Motion that imitates marking: swipes, pen strokes drawn on, notes inked in, staggered.

rules.name: The Red Pen Rule
rules.body: Red means the teacher touched it: scores, corrections, errors, warnings, focus. Never use pen red for decoration, branding or a neutral call to action at rest.

rules.name: The Highlighter Code Rule
rules.body: The four highlighters belong to the four parts (topic, summary, reaction, conclusion) and are set by `data-part`. A part keeps the same colour on every surface, and a highlighter never appears on text that does not belong to, or name, its part.

rules.name: The Part Ink Rule
rules.body: Text that names a part is coloured with that part's ink, never with the translucent highlighter, which is only ever a background.

rules.name: The Tally Rule
rules.body: Every count, score, limit and draft number is set in Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono with tabular figures (`.nums`). Prose numbers stay in the body face only when they are part of a sentence.

rules.name: The On-Grid Rule
rules.body: Writing and read-back text uses a line-height equal to the grid (28px) so lines sit on the squares.

rules.name: The One Sheet Shadow Rule
rules.body: Paper is the only surface with elevation. Cards, panels and boxes inside a sheet stay flat and use rule-colour hairlines.

dos: Do put every content area on a sheet (paper, 28px grid, 4px corners, the sheet shadow) over the desk colour.
Do keep the margin rule at 212px with content at 236px on any sheet with a margin column, and move it to 16px below 1024px.
Do colour a part by setting `data-part` and letting it supply both the highlighter and the part ink.
Do set every number in the mono face with tabular figures.
Do draw marking (score circles, ticks, crosses, underlines) as SVG pen strokes in pen red, drawn on with `pen-draw` and staggered.
Do use expo-out (`cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`) for entrances and swipes, and turn all of it off under reduced motion, leaving pen strokes fully drawn.
Do show corrections as a 2px red strike-through on the wrong text followed by the fix in semibold red.
donts: Don't use pen red at rest for anything that is not marking, an error, focus, or a hover response.
Don't put a highlighter colour on text that is not part of, or the name of, its paragraph part.
Don't add paper texture, handwriting or script fonts, or page-curl effects; the pen exists only in SVG strokes.
Don't nest shadowed cards inside a sheet; separate with rule-colour hairlines.
Don't round controls beyond 2px or use pill buttons.
Don't set small uppercase tracked labels above a heading or section as an eyebrow; the label role is for keying individual items only.
